ai.answer: Only PDF content or your MarIAna question, with your explicit consent. Review it under Settings → Legal.

subscription.question: How does Premium work?
subscription.answer: The free plan includes up to 3 policies. Premium unlocks unlimited policies, MarIAna, and cloud extraction.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: This document is a placeholder draft for InsurWallet. It will be replaced by legally reviewed terms before public launch.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
acceptance.body: By using InsurWallet you accept these terms. If you disagree, do not use the service.

service.title: 2. Service description
service.body: InsurWallet is a platform to organize insurance policies, related documents, and AI assistance (MarIAna). We are not an insurer and do not broker policy contracts.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts and subscriptions
accounts.body: The free plan includes up to 3 policies. Premium features (unlimited policies, cloud AI) require a paid subscription. Pricing and billing terms will be published in the app.

ai.title: 4. Use of artificial intelligence
ai.body: Cloud AI features process documents and queries under your explicit consent. Results are informational and do not constitute legal, financial, or insurance advice.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
liability.body: InsurWallet is provided "as is". Always verify policy information with your insurer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document is a placeholder draft aligned with Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012 (Habeas Data) and GDPR principles. It will be reviewed by legal counsel before launch.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: InsurWallet, based in Colombia, is responsible for processing your personal data. Contact:

items.account: Account data: email, name, language preferences.
items.policies: Policy data: information you enter or extract from documents.
items.documents: PDF/image documents you upload for processing (with your consent for cloud AI).
items.technical: Technical data: usage logs, device identifiers.

purpose.title: 3. Purposes
purpose.body: Service delivery, renewal reminders, document processing, MarIAna assistance, legal compliance, and product improvement.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis and consent
legalBasis.body: Processing is based on contract performance, consent (especially for cloud AI and non-essential cookies), and legitimate interest in security and fraud prevention.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body: You may access, rectify, delete, object, withdraw consent, and request portability from Settings → Export my data / Delete account.

retention.title: 6. Retention and security
retention.body: We retain data while you maintain your account. We apply encryption in transit, per-user access rules, and audit logs for sensitive actions.

transfers.title: 7. International transfers
transfers.body: Some providers (e.g. cloud infrastructure, AI) may process data outside Colombia with appropriate contractual safeguards.
